name: metpy-structured-decorator-invocation-ccf0
instr:
MetPy cannot inspect how decorated calls are adapted across stacked wrappers, including actual callable execution. Add opt-in capture without changing ordinary results or control flow.

An active `ObservationCapture` records each entered wrapper and underlying callable as immutable `CallObservation` and `CallEvent` values. Inactive calls leave no capture state. Globally monotonic event sequences, stable callable identities, unique invocation identities, and parent links reconstruct nested execution order. Each entered invocation has exactly one terminal outcome. `CallOutcome` is a Enum with `SUCCESS`, `FAILURE`, `WARNING`, and `SKIPPED`; a compatibility warning makes every entered invocation `WARNING`, never `SUCCESS`.

`EventKind` is a Enum describing only adaptations that occur: positional, keyword, and unchanged pandas arguments; unit validation and declared conversions; Xarray broadcasting, casting, coordinate matching, quantity extraction, and output wrapping; grid dimensions, deltas, CRS values, and map-scale arguments, distinguishing inferred values from caller-supplied values; and inferred, explicit, and fallback derivative coordinates. `WrapperKind` is a Enum covering `GRID_ARGUMENTS`, `XARRAY_DERIVATIVE`, `DEPRECATION`, `PANDAS`, `TESTING`, `UNITS`, and `XARRAY`.

Nested and concurrent captures are context-local. Propagation includes inner observations only when selected. `ObservationQuery` intersects its populated criteria. Bounded capture deterministically retains
